gloss: period of stay; length of stay; duration of visit

definitions.gloss: period of stay; length of stay; duration of visit
definitions.explanation: The amount of time one stays in a particular place, often used in the context of travel, immigration, or hotel stays.

examples.japanese: {滞在期間|たいざいきかん}は{一週間|いっしゅうかん}です。
examples.english: The period of stay is one week.

examples.japanese: ビザの{滞在期間|たいざいきかん}を{延長|えんちょう}したい。
examples.english: I want to extend the period of stay on my visa.

examples.japanese: {滞在期間|たいざいきかん}が{短|みじか}かったので、あまり{観光|かんこう}できなかった。
examples.english: My stay was short, so I couldn't do much sightseeing.

notes:
A compound of {滞在|たいざい} (stay, sojourn) + {期間|きかん} (period, duration). Commonly used in travel, immigration, and accommodation contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {滞在期間|たいざいきかん}を{延長|えんちょう}する: to extend the period of stay
- {滞在期間|たいざいきかん}が{過|す}ぎる: for the stay period to expire
- {滞在期間|たいざいきかん}を{超|こ}える: to exceed the allowed stay period
- {最長|さいちょう}{滞在期間|たいざいきかん}: maximum period of stay

USAGE:
Frequently encountered in visa applications, hotel booking forms, and immigration-related documents. Also used informally when discussing travel plans.

RELATED WORDS:
- {滞在|たいざい}: stay, sojourn — the act of staying itself
- {在留期間|ざいりゅうきかん}: period of residence — used specifically for immigration/visa contexts in Japan
